collective_memory.summary: Compressed rounds 1-10: Gift buyers loved the grow-it idea but repeatedly raised delivery date, refund terms and sizes; a few preordered early, most hesitated, and sentiment stayed cautiously mixed.
Compressed rounds 11-20: Gift buyers were relieved by on-time arrivals and loved sprouts, but a dead gift plant and the missing growing guide pushed cautious members back toward hesitation.
